events.detail: Helmwill confirmed project brief. Discrepancies acknowledged: DB is MySQL not SQLite, CI is CircleCI not GitHub Actions, branch is master. Day 1 fan-out starting — 5 agents launched in parallel: Infra (S1.1-S1.5), Strategy Dev (S2.1-S2.4), Backend Dev (S4.1-S4.3 S5.1), CI/CD Builder (S6.1-S6.2), QA Agent (S7.1-S7.3).
